$comment: Type-checks the design-sync preview cards against the package's built types.
The previews live outside src/ and so were checked by nothing. That is not a
theoretical gap: the palette migration renamed a Surface tone and the preview kept
passing the old value, which React happily renders as a missing background rather
than an error. A card that quietly loses its surface still screenshots, still
grades, and looks merely 'a bit flat'.
Run after `npm run build` — it checks against dist/, so the types must exist.
